description: Windkraftzonen gem. §20 NÖ ROG 2014 (Kundmachung vom 02.09.2024) is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sdi.noe.gv.at. Zonen aus dem sektoralen Raumordnungsprogramm über die Windkraftnutzung in NÖ gemäß § 20 Abs. 3b NÖ ROG 2014, auf denen die Widmung Grünland - Windkraftanlage zulässig ist. D.h., dass die Widmungsart Grünland - Windkraftanlagen (Gwka) durch die Gemeinden nach dem üblichen Widmungsprozedere (Änderung des örtlichen Raumordnungsprogrammes) noch festzulegen ist. Coverage: AT. Its keywords include Energie, Zoneneinteilung, Raumplanung, Wind. The listing shows 6 download or service links in JSON, WFS, SHP, KML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
